2607.18961.title: From Dependency to Compositionality: A Neurosymbolic Lifting of LLM Outputs via Combinatory Categorial Grammar
2607.18961.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) generate fluent text by incrementally predicting the next token from a prefix. Critics in the generative tradition argue that such systems lack genuine grammar; influential replies from the dependency-grammar perspective hold that LLM behavior is well described by local head-dependent structure built word by word. We argue that a sharper observation has been overlooked: the prefix-driven, type-completing dynamics of autoregressive generation align closely with the incremental processing model that Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG) was originally designed to support. On this basis we propose a neurosymbolic framework in which LLM outputs are lifted into typed compositional derivations -- not claiming that LLMs implement CCG internally, but that their outputs admit a principled, incremental, and auditable CCG reconstruction. Two consequences follow. First, through the Curry-Howard correspondence the lifting extends beyond natural language to the formal languages LLMs also produce -- programming languages such as Solidity, description-logic and query languages such as OWL and SQL -- with the type system varying and the architecture held fixed. Second, the lifting supports two layers of checking: a compositional layer that catches structural failures directly, and a content layer that checks the lifted structure against external knowledge sources, enabling the earliest possible flagging of hallucinated content. The account thereby requires of a producer not cognition but a prefix-driven generative profile. We close with a sketch of synchronous LLM-CCG coupling as one direction the framework opens.
2607.18961.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）透過逐步預測前綴的下一個標記來生成流暢的文本。生成傳統中的批評者認為這類系統缺乏真正的語法；來自依賴語法觀點的有影響力的回應認為，LLM的行為可以通過逐字建立的局部頭依賴結構來很好地描述。我們主張一個更尖銳的觀察被忽視了：自回歸生成的前綴驅動、類型完成動態與組合類別語法（CCG）最初設計支持的增量處理模型密切對齊。在此基礎上，我們提出一個神經符號框架，其中LLM的輸出被提升為類型組合推導——並不聲稱LLM在內部實現CCG，而是它們的輸出允許一個原則性的、增量的和可審計的CCG重建。由此產生兩個後果。首先，通過Curry-Howard對應，提升超越自然語言擴展到LLM也生成的形式語言——如Solidity的編程語言、描述邏輯和查詢語言如OWL和SQL——類型系統變化而架構保持不變。其次，提升支持兩層檢查：一個組合層直接捕捉結構失敗，另一個內容層則檢查提升的結構與外部知識來源的對應，從而使得最早可能標記出幻覺內容。因此，這一說明要求生產者不需要認知，而是需要一個前綴驅動的生成特徵。我們以同步的LLM-CCG耦合的概述作為該框架開啟的一個方向結束。
2607.18961.author: Remo Pareschi et.al.
